tldr: Jupiter through the 2nd house expands money, security, values, and self-worth.
body:
When Jupiter moves through your 2nd house, it makes more room around money, security, possessions, self-worth, spending, income, and what helps you feel steady. You may notice what feels worth keeping, what costs too much, and what would help life feel more stable.

Hope, appetite, confidence, opportunity, and risk can all get bigger. It can help you say yes to something that gives your life more range.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for making a more honest choice around resources, desire, and value.

The caution: Watch for taking on more than the situation, your schedule, or your judgment can hold. The risk is confusing immediate comfort with real security.

Jupiter moves through this house for about a year. Let the opening be real, but keep your promises sized to the life you can actually live.
